qa_pairs.question: What is the torque specification for the support frame on body (1AZ)?
What screw type is used for the gas density sensor on non-return cock of gas tank?
How much torque should be applied to the gas density sensor on the non-return cock of the gas tank?
Which component has the lowest torque specification in this fuel system table?
qa_pairs.answer: The holder for filler connections on body (4AZ) has the lowest torque specification at 3 Nm

qa_pairs.question: Which components use the 316g/518g screw type?
qa_pairs.answer: The support frame on body (1AZ) and the gas density sensor on non-return cock of gas tank (2AZ)

qa_pairs.question: What is the highest torque specification shown in this fuel system attachment table?
qa_pairs.answer: 45 Nm for the support frame on body (1AZ)
